facts.summary: Discontinued both trials after no meaningful ONCT-534 response; exploring strategic alternatives · Phase 1 · ONCT-534 in metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer · not yet approved

evidence.summary: interim Phase 1 study results of ONCT-534 did not show clinically meaningful improvements of disease, including prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels, in the 20 patients treated in eight dosing cohorts
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: interim Phase 1 study results of ONCT-534 did not show clinically meaningful improvements of disease, including prostate-specific antigen (PSA) levels
evidence.safety: ONCT-534 was generally well tolerated, with dose limiting toxicity observed in 2 of 3 patients at the highest dose tested, 1200 mg given orally once per day.
evidence.program_discontinued: Based on the available clinical data and capital requirements for continued development, Oncternal has decided to terminate these studies.
